network.legend: Each node is an actor, with its name below. Color is the latest model; shape is the kind. Faded nodes are stopped actors. Click a node to open its profile; hover over a name to see model · effort and state. You can drag nodes (reload the page to restore the layout).

keys.continued: Dotted arrow: continued (/clear handoff or fork)

timeline.title: Timeline · callboard
timeline.heading: Timeline
timeline.legend: The horizontal axis is the time castlist received (Japan time). Each row is an actor: humans first, then the rest by first entry. Bars are running periods, split where model or effort changed. Hover over a bar to see its values and times. Click a name to open the profile. Actors: {{n}}.

keys.launched: Solid line: launched (from the launch time to the start of the launched actor's bar)
keys.continued: Dotted line: continued (from the end of the previous bar to the start of the next)
keys.open: Pointed right end: still running (or continues past the shown period)
keys.inferred: Dotted bar: closed after roster inferred a crash when heartbeats stopped (up to the inferred exit)

usage.tooMany: There were too many records to read them all (read {{read}} rows). The numbers below cover only what was read. Narrow the period.
usage.tooSlow: Could not read all records in time (read {{read}} rows). The numbers below cover only what was read. Narrow the period.

byContext.heading: Cost by context length band (main session turns)
byContext.legend: The horizontal axis is context length (bands of {{width}}; ticks mark each band's lower edge), the vertical axis is the cost of turns in that band. The dotted line is 200k. Hover over a bar to see the band, cost and number of turns.
byContext.empty: No main session turns in this period.

bySlot.heading: Cost per {{unit}} (Japan time)
bySlot.legend: Each row's {{unit}} is set by the end time of the record's interval. Periods up to 1 day are shown per hour; longer periods per day (split at midnight Japan time).
bySlot.table: Show cost per {{unit}} as a table

notes.cost: Cost is an estimate of usage at API prices, not an amount paid.

groups.before: Roles are grouped by the label
groups.subject: , issues by the label

notes.context: Context lengths (median, top 10%, longest context, turns ≥ 200k) count the main session's turns only (helper (subagent) turns run in their own short contexts, so they are left out).
notes.bands: The median and top 10% are approximations from bands of {{width}} (the lower edge of the band the turn falls in; "225k–" means at least 225k and under 250k).
notes.delay: Numbers for running seats can lag by up to about an hour.
